name: Loot Magnet
description: Walk around and the loot comes to you, without pressing E: the loot of creatures killed near you, items on the ground (drops, sticks and stones after chopping or mining) and collectibles; by choice also mushrooms, fireflies, wild plants, chests in ruins and barrels, crates and urns to smash. On the host or a dedicated server it works for every player, also those who joined without EMF; each switches their own with /loot.toggle. Never inside a base, never a player's chest, never a quest item.

settings.label: Reach (m)
settings.help: Corpses, and everything else below whose own reach is 0, this close to a player come to them.

settings.label: After the kill (s)
settings.help: The loot comes no sooner than this after the death.

settings.label: Looks for loot for (s)
settings.help: After the kill. The loot appears 1-3 s after the death; older loot is left to you.

settings.label: What comes

options.label: Corpses that hold only materials (and food)

settings.help: A corpse with gear in it is left for you to open.

settings.label: Items on the ground
settings.help: Drops, sticks and stones after chopping or mining, what a smashed barrel drops, loose stones and twig piles, creature drops, and the stones, ore, wood, meat and drinks that lie in ruins. Never keys, weapons or lore the game placed in the world.

settings.label: Reach for items on the ground (m)
settings.help: 0 = the general reach above.

settings.label: Collectibles
settings.help: The collection items lying in the world.

settings.label: Reach for collectibles (m)
settings.help: 0 = the general reach above.

settings.label: Mushrooms
settings.help: Wild mushrooms you pick with E.

settings.label: Reach for mushrooms (m)
settings.help: 0 = the general reach above.

settings.label: Fireflies and bait bugs
settings.help: Fireflies and the other critters that are fishing bait.

settings.label: Reach for fireflies (m)
settings.help: 0 = the general reach above.

settings.label: Wild plants
settings.help: Herbs, flowers, bushes, wild crops and wild shiitake you collect with E. Never a planted crop, never in a base.

settings.label: Reach for wild plants (m)
settings.help: 0 = the general reach above.

settings.label: Never pick up (item names)
settings.help: Item names as `items <words>` in the console shows them, comma separated; end one with * for every name that begins so (Food_T1_raw_*).

settings.label: Chests in ruins
settings.help: Opens and empties the chests the game placed in the world, as if you had opened them. Never a player's chest, never one that needs a lockpick or a key, never one that holds a quest item, never one another player opened.

settings.label: Reach for chests (m)
settings.help: 0 = the general reach above.

settings.label: Smash barrels, crates and urns
settings.help: Only those that drop loot (never enemy spawners or nests), never within 10 m more than the base distance below. What they drop lies on the ground (Items on the ground picks it up).

settings.label: Reach for smashing (m)
settings.help: 0 = the general reach above.

settings.label: On for players who never switched it
settings.help: Each player switches their own with /loot.toggle (kept per world and account).

settings.label: Your key to switch it
settings.help: The host's own magnet; empty = no key (loot.toggle in the console works too).

settings.label: Never within (m) of a flame altar
settings.help: Nothing inside a base is looted or picked up.

settings.label: Log every decision
settings.help: A line in emf_core.log for each death noted and each corpse looted or left, with the reason; and what each sweep picked up.
